card.name: Flitter Dance
card.tagline: traditional dance from the Isle of Man associated with Good Friday
card.profile: The Flitter Dance (Flitter Daunsey in Manx) is a traditional dance from the Isle of Man associated with Good Friday. It was collected by Mona Douglas in the 1940s or 50s and is popular among younger Manx dancers today.
card.insight: A dance was collected in connection to these customs by Mona Douglas, who first mentioned it as ‘partly noted but still incomplete’ in 1937.
sources: Source: Flitter Dance on Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0. Read: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flitter_Dance
card.sacred_note: The dance and its associated food-throwing ritual are described as a survival of an ancient Gaelic ceremony of propitiation or sacrifice to the powers of the sea.
